## What it catches

Files over 300 lines (warn).

## Preset setting

```json
{
  "style": {
    "noExcessiveLinesPerFile": {
      "level": "warn",
      "options": {
        "maxLines": 300,
        "skipBlankLines": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```
